profile.headline: TN (Treaty National) Visa | DevOps Engineer | Software Developer | Full-Stack Developer | Cloud Engineer | Solutions Architect
profile.jobTitle: Senior DevOps Engineer | Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: I am a Software Developer with 13 years of experiences focus in the programming languages like: Ruby, Python, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, C, C++, PHP. I created different applications, informatic systems and electronics devices using frameworks like: RoR (Ruby on Rails), Chef, Django, Android SDK, AWS SDK, React JS, Spark Core, Symfony and using different public clouds like: AWS (Amazon Web Services), GCP (Google Cloud Platform) and private clouds like: VMware. The develop of these applications and systems were reachable under my managing and I had 6 persons under my direction. In the last 7 years I managed and migrated applications from On-Premise to GCP and AWS clouds. I worked with multinational companies how TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), AWS (Amazon Web Services), SAP and local companies and universities. One of my greatest achievements was to migrate and automate the deployment of one application from On-Premise to AWS cloud, this application had different environments of development and was developed under framework .Net; the implemented process allows you to compile, test, and deploy the application every time the code is modified, in addition to reducing the time from 1 hour to 5 minutes in deployment and, in the same way, avoiding human errors in the process.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer | Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	I developed multiple web components to allow the client request different kind of credit cards.
•	I designed and created unit, integration test using TDD (Test Driven Development) methodology.
•	I implemented multiple validations in the frontend and backend to accomplish with the requirements of the application.
•	I updated API REST services from Spring Boot 2.7 to 3.2.
•	I created and designed Kibana dashboards to see the performances, errors, concurrency and load charge time of multiple applications. 
•	I designed and implemented Functions as a Services (FaaS) to replace on premise services.

The above was done with different technologies such as: Terraform, Java, JavaScript, React JS, Redux, TypeScript, Git, GitLab, Jest, Cypress, TDD (Test Driven Development), Scrum, SAFe, Jira, Java, Spring Boot, Kibana, OpenShift, Python, JSON, Yaml.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Java · JavaScript · React.js · Redux.js · TypeScript · Git · GitHub · GitLab · Jest · Cypress · TDD · Scrum · Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) · JIRA · Spring Boot · Kibana · Openshift · Python · JSON · YAML

positions.title: Senior AWS Engineer
positions.locationName: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	I migrated and created pipelines in Jenkins that allowed the compilation, test and deployment of an application developed in .NET which was stored in a GitLab repository and finally was deployed in a Fargate container in AWS cloud.
•	I created one artefact/template that allow the automatic deployment of Chef-Infra server in the AWS cloud.
•	Evaluated and delivered a report to the customer on their DevOps capabilities, this evaluation and report were based on the following five pillars:
o	Organization Adoption
o	Development Lifecycle
o	Quality Assurance
o	Automated Governance.
o	Observability
•	I made the infrastructure diagrams, as well as the template in CloudFormation/Terraform to later carry out the deployment of the landing zone in AWS for the client’s SAP systems.
•	I deployed the SDLF (Serverless Data Lake Framework) framework using Bitbucket as central repository. I created a custom pipeline that was integrated in the framework to ingest data with AWS Glue.
•	I developed a web application based on React JS and AWS API System Manager that allow manage the SAP systems, the main actions on the systems that is possible to execute are: Start, stop, reboot. Whit this application is easier, faster and secure manage the SAP system because avoid login in the system and only user with permission on IAM services on AWS could execute the action.
•	I used the AWS Ruby SDK to deploy and run different Ruby on Rails (RoR) applications in the AWS Cloud. I created an API with Ruby on Rails (RoR) to obtain metrics from the EC2 and to send a report every day to know the health of the EC2 machines.

The above was done with different technologies such as: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Lambda, Bitbucket, GitLab, AWS SDLF, AWS IAM, AWS VPC, AWS Lambda, AWS ECS, AWS ECR, AWS EKS, AWS CDK, AWS CodeCommit, AWS Fargate, AWS S3, AWS CodePipeline, AWS RDS, Postgres, Jenkins, React JS, Ruby on Rails (RoR), AWS Ruby SDK, Python, AWS Glue.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.locationName: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	I participated in the "Self Service" project that allow to patch, create catalogs (images) and deploy virtual machines in a vCenter. The project has five microservices each do different tasks:
o	Serv 1: Schedule and launch a task.
o	Serv 2: Steps to complete a task.
o	Serv 3: Connects the other microservices with vCloud and the Database.
o	Serv 4: Microservice that allowed the user to program the different tasks: patch, catalog and deploy.
o	Serv 5: Service that monitored the status and health of all microservices.
•	I made health reports of the virtual machines hosted in different vCenters and GCP cloud, some information obtained was the following:
o	Cluster information
o	Operating System of Virtual machines 
o	Number of Virtual Machines per datastore
o	Virtual Machines with incorrect OS configuration
•	I created reports from vCenter that helped to know the causes of unknown problems about RAM and storage. The error logs were stored in a MySQL database and the information was obtained with the programming language ruby and the Ruby on Rails (RoR) framework, to show the information was use React JS library.
•	I took a course in Linux Academy to understand the parts of the Chef framework and created my local environment "Chef-server, Workstation and Node" to understand the architecture, operation and development of cookbooks, recipes, databag, etc.
•	I created and developed the next plugins and cookbooks with Chef framework:
o	Plugin that obtains what kind of database the system has: Hana, Sybase, Maxdb, MySql. After the plugin install the system with the database configuration
o	Cookbook that detects the type of system and automatically mount the external disks.
o	Cookbook and recipes that stop and start the systems: Hadoop, Hybris, Hana, Bobj, Innovation Management, Plant connectivity, Dp agents.

The above was done with: Terraform, Java, Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot, Chef, GCP (Compute Engine,  Cloud Storage, Filestore, Network, Monitoring, Cloud Functions, APIs)

positions.title: Systems Coordinator
positions.description:
•	I coordinated, designed, developed, tested the system called DOSELI, which allows to carry out the revision of all the dispensers that the company has installed in different hospitals/restaurants across of States of the Mexican Republic. With the system is easy provide correct and punctual service to the hospitals. The system can be used in any web browser and phone with Android operative system. The Web Part was developed with Ruby on Rails (RoR) technology and framework; The mobile application was developed in Java language with the Android Studio IDE.
•	I developed an application to measure handwashing compliance in a room based on WHO's five moments. The application was developed in Java language with the Android Studio IDE.
•	I developed and programmed an electronic attachment with the spark core hardware to convert an electronic dispenser into an intelligent electronic dispenser; This attachment checks the conditions of the equipment, such as quantity of use, battery level, and amount of liquid remaining. The programming of this attachment was developed under the C language.
database; Finally, to show the information is done with the language PHP, JavaScript and HTML.
•	I developed a shipping system in Ruby on Rails (RoR) that allows to organize and notify the packages of products sent to the different offices of the company.
•	I developed a system of assistances that allows to obtain the register of the employees of the clock, with which it is known and control the attendances, delays, permissions, vacations, disabilities, and bonus of punctuality. The project was developed with the Ruby on Rails (RoR) framework.
•	I developed a system to view and report sales of the company by customer or seller either monthly, fortnightly, or weekly. The system obtains the information of the system Aspel SAE that is with which the company invoices and allows to show it in any Web browser. It was developed with Ruby on Rails (RoR).
